full_name: Rachel S. Goldman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2005–2006 Biological Sciences Augustus Anson Whitney Fellow University of Michigan
bio: Rachel S. Goldman’s research interests are in the atomic-scale design of electronic materials, with a focus on the mechanisms of strain relaxation, alloy formation, and diffusion and correlations between microstructure and electronic, magnetic, and optical properties of semiconductor films, nanostructures, and heterostructures.
